options.text: A family of large language models made by Anthropic, plus the assistant and products built on them
A search engine that looks up every answer on the web
A database that stores your past conversations

questions.explanation: Anthropic's docs describe Claude as a family of large language models developed by Anthropic. The name also covers the assistant and products like Claude Code built on those models.

questions.prompt: Everything Claude can see at once in a conversation (messages, files, instructions) is called its context ____.
questions.explanation: The context window is Claude's working memory: 1 million tokens on current models.

questions.prompt: Which of these are good reasons to turn on web search? Select all that apply.

options.text: You're asking about events after the model's knowledge cutoff
You need current prices or recent news
You want Claude to rewrite a paragraph you pasted
You want sources you can open and verify

questions.explanation: Current models have a June 2026 knowledge cutoff, so recent facts need web search, which also provides citations. Rewriting text you pasted doesn't need the web.

questions.prompt: Order the widely available model tiers from fastest to most capable.
questions.explanation: Haiku is the fastest, Sonnet balances speed and intelligence, Opus handles deep long-running work, and Fable is the most capable widely released tier.

questions.prompt: Match each term to its meaning.

pairs.right: A small chunk of text Claude reads and writes
The date after which training data stops
Everything Claude can see in a conversation at once

questions.explanation: Tokens are the unit of text and billing, the knowledge cutoff limits what the model knows, Anthropic trains Claude, and the context window is its working memory.

questions.prompt: You ask Claude to make a photorealistic picture of a beach. What should you expect?

options.text: Claude doesn't generate photos like image models; it can build diagrams and visuals with code instead
An error that ends the conversation
A random image downloaded from the web

questions.explanation: Per the Help Center, Claude doesn't generate photos or illustrations the way image-generation tools do. It creates diagrams, charts, and visuals with HTML and SVG, and it can analyze images you upload.
